reported: deck 39 (V.1_66): How the solution is deployed
title: How the solution is deployed

spec.title: How the solution is deployed
spec.lead: Automated infrastructure pipelines provision networking, compute, clustering and database replication in sequence.

items.label: Stage 1
items.title: Network and identity
points: Deploy multi-region VPC and subnets via Terraform
Configure firewall rules for ports 1433 and 5022
Extend Active Directory domain controllers to both regions
Provision Cloud DNS private zones and witness share

items.label: Stage 2
items.title: Compute and storage
points: Provision three n2-highmem-32 VMs across target zones
Attach and format pd-extreme and pd-ssd disks
Join SQL Server nodes to Contoso.com domain
Install Cloud Monitoring Ops Agent on all nodes

items.label: Stage 3
items.title: Cluster and always on
points: Configure WSFC across the three domain-joined nodes
Enable Always On Availability Groups on SQL Server
Configure TCP 5022 endpoints and availability replicas
Deploy internal load balancers and TCP health probes

items.label: Stage 4
items.title: Seeding and validation
points: Run automatic seeding to initialize secondary replicas
Verify synchronous commit status in Region 1
Verify asynchronous log shipping to Region 2
Execute pre-cutover zone failover test with DBAs

spec.notes:
We deploy the environment in four sequential stages using Terraform for Google Cloud resources and PowerShell Desired State Configuration for Windows and SQL Server setup. No production clinical databases cut over until Stage 4 validates both synchronous local failover and asynchronous remote log shipping.

Sources:
[1] Reference Architecture: High-Availability Microsoft SQL Server Databases Using Always On Availability Groups (Google Cloud, 2024) https://cloud.google.com/solutions/sql-server-always-on-availability-groups-compute-engine
[2] Deploying Microsoft SQL Server for Multi-Regional Disaster Recovery (Google Cloud, 2024) https://cloud.google.com/solutions/sql-server-multi-regional-disaster-recovery
